title: Rows of Ten on the Chart

steps.body: The hundred chart shows every number to 100. Each row holds exactly ten.
steps.narration: The hundred chart shows every number to 100. Each row holds exactly ten.

widget.prompt: Each chart row adds ten. Start at 14 and go down one row: hop one ten. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That is the next square in the SAME row. Down one row is ten more: 24.
That is the row ABOVE. Down from 14 is 24.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 14 and count on one: you land on 24.
widget.successFeedback: One row down from 14 is 24 — ten more.

predict.prompt: On the chart, is the square below 14 bigger or smaller than 14?
predict.reveal: Rows count up as you go down the chart: below 14 sits 24, ten more.
